Performance Mode: the phone is hot, so background load is being eased to keep frame rates steady.

Fewer lag spikes and smoother screen flips: a calmer memory collector, top priority for the render thread, and a temperature watch that eases background load when the phone gets hot. Applies on the next launch. It never changes your resolution or your game options.
